description.zh: 列出已保存与附近的 Wi-Fi：Enter 连接，Ctrl+Enter 断开，Shift+Enter 查看密码（UAC），支持忘记网络与复制配置；纯 wlanapi，不解析 netsh
description.en: List saved and nearby Wi-Fi networks: Enter connects, Ctrl+Enter disconnects, Shift+Enter reveals the password (UAC); forget or copy profiles. Native wlanapi, no netsh parsing

hint.zh: 留空看当前连接与已保存网络；输入筛选 SSID
hint.en: empty shows the current connection and saved networks; type to filter SSID

ai.description: Show the current Wi-Fi connection (SSID, band, channel, signal, auth), saved profiles and visible networks with signal strength. Actions connect, disconnect, reveal or copy the password (elevated), copy the profile XML, or forget a network. Passwords are never persisted.

hint.zh: 关闭后查看时直接明文显示
hint.en: when off, revealed passwords show in plain text
